title: Config History
desc: Each time a configuration file is overwritten, the previous version is saved automatically. Compare any version with the current one and roll back in one click.
keepHint: Up to 30 versions are kept per configuration. Account and token files are excluded.
empty: No history yet. Versions appear after the first change.
restoreConfirm: Roll {name} back to the version saved at {time}? Gately will restart to apply it. The current content is kept as a new version, so you can undo the rollback.
